decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service option that builds on existing production and is still mentioned, so keeping it open while demand resolves costs little.

The seventy-two-hour delivery program is cheap to maintain on the website, but it overlaps with the other express offers and may be consolidated; its value is still uncertain, so it stays open for now.
The express product line has had its own page in both years, which shows continued commitment, so the option is being exercised rather than abandoned.
The digital ordering platform is a strategic infrastructure option that supports the firm's service direction, has its own page in both years, and costs little at the margin to keep.
The fire and smoke protection door was promoted to its own page in 2024, which signals positive results and further commitment, unlike the dropped fire-resistant exterior door.
